text: 截至目前，ETF两市成交额报5044.11亿元，较昨日此时缩量543.54亿元，分类型来看，股票型ETF成交额2083.69亿元，债券型ETF成交额1433.23亿元，货币型ETF成交额592.94亿元，商品型ETF成交额98.44亿元，QDII型ETF成交额835.81亿元。其中，成交额最高的非货币型ETF分别是中韩半导体ETF（513310）、科创50ETF（588000）、创业板ETF（159915），成交额分别为：215.14亿元、166.95亿元、131.18亿元。
text_en: As of now, ETF turnover in the Shanghai and Shenzhen markets was RMB 504.411 billion, down RMB 54.354 billion from the same time yesterday. By category, equity ETF turnover was RMB 208.369 billion, bond ETF turnover was RMB 143.323 billion, money market ETF turnover was RMB 59.294 billion, commodity ETF turnover was RMB 9.844 billion, and QDII ETF turnover was RMB 83.581 billion. Among non-money-market ETFs, the highest-turnover funds were the China-Korea Semiconductor ETF (513310), the STAR 50 ETF (588000) and the ChiNext ETF (159915), with turnover of RMB 21.514 billion, RMB 16.695 billion and RMB 13.118 billion, respectively.
